scenarios.title: Create a Product with Valid Information
scenarios.business_objective: Allow signed-in users to add new products with valid details including edge boundary cases.
preconditions: User is authenticated and signed in.
User is on the product management form page.
steps: Enter a valid Product Name of exactly 50 characters.
Select a valid Category from the dropdown ('Books').
Enter a non-negative Price with 2 decimal places (e.g., '29.99').
Optionally enter a valid Description within 500 characters.
scenarios.expected_result: The Save button becomes disabled while saving, and the product is successfully created and added to the catalog.

scenarios.title: Validation Failure for Blank or Oversized Product Name
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure product names are required and strictly enforced to 1–50 characters.
preconditions: User is attempting to save a product form.
steps: Attempt to save a product with a blank or empty Product Name.
Observe the validation error message displayed.
Enter a Product Name containing 51 characters.
Attempt to save the product form again.
Observe the validation error message displayed.
scenarios.expected_result: An empty name triggers 'Name is required'. A 51-character name triggers 'Name must be at most 50 characters'. Form submission is halted.
